Title: Repair meeting room cooling
Description: The large meeting room stays warm despite the cooling being on. Check airflow and service the fan coil.

Title: Replace reception downlight driver
Description: The reception downlights flicker after switching on. Check the driver and replace the faulty unit.

Title: Repair accessible washroom tap
Description: The accessible washroom tap drips continuously. Replace the cartridge and check for leaks.

Title: Adjust loading bay door closer
Description: The loading bay fire door slams shut. Adjust the closer and verify safe closing.

Title: Clear kitchenette sink blockage
Description: Water backs up in the kitchenette sink. Clear the trap and test drainage.

Title: Replace stairwell emergency light battery
Description: The emergency light on the second floor failed its monthly test. Replace the battery and retest.

Title: Inspect rooftop ventilation noise
Description: The rooftop extractor makes a rattling noise. Check mountings and fan bearings.

Title: Repair lobby access control reader
Description: The lobby reader intermittently rejects valid badges. Check wiring and reader alignment.

Title: Seal condensation leak above reception
Description: Condensation drips from the ceiling near reception. Inspect insulation and drain lines.

Title: Replace corridor inspection hatch
Description: The corridor inspection hatch has a broken hinge. Replace the hinge and secure the panel.

Title: Service parking gate safety sensor
Description: The parking gate reverses without an obstruction. Clean and align the safety sensors.

Title: Repair shower drain odour
Description: An odour is coming from the staff shower drain. Check the trap seal and flush the drain.

Title: Secure loose handrail bracket
Description: A stairwell handrail bracket is loose. Secure the bracket and check the surrounding fixings.

Title: Replace storage unit door seal
Description: Dust is entering under the storage door. Fit a new bottom seal and check clearance.

Title: Restore lift lobby ventilation
Description: The lift lobby extractor does not start. Test the supply and replace the failed control if needed.

Title: Repair pantry cabinet hinge
Description: The pantry cabinet door hangs unevenly. Replace the damaged hinge and align the door.

Title: Inspect water booster pump vibration
Description: The water pump vibrates during morning demand. Check mountings and coupling alignment.

Title: Replace car park floodlight
Description: The rear car park floodlight does not illuminate. Test power and replace the failed fitting.

Title: Clean air handling unit filters
Description: Dust buildup is reducing airflow. Replace filters and record the pressure difference.

Title: Repair washroom exhaust timer
Description: The washroom fan stops too soon. Check the timer setting and test operation.

Title: Replace damaged socket faceplate
Description: A cracked socket faceplate was found in the print room. Isolate the circuit and replace it.

Title: Adjust roof access door latch
Description: The roof access door does not latch reliably. Align the strike plate and verify closure.

Title: Repair irrigation valve leak
Description: A valve box fills with water after watering. Locate the leak and replace the seal.

Title: Test emergency exit signage
Description: The east exit sign is dim. Check the fitting and test backup operation.

Title: Repair reception desk cable grommet
Description: A damaged grommet exposes a sharp desk edge. Replace it and secure the cables.

Title: Inspect chilled water valve operation
Description: The office cooling cycles unevenly. Check actuator travel and valve operation.

Title: Replace broken soap dispenser
Description: The washroom dispenser pump is stuck. Fit a replacement and test dispensing.

Title: Repair service yard drain cover
Description: The drain cover rocks when walked on. Reseat the frame and secure the cover.

Title: Inspect corridor motion sensor
Description: Corridor lights remain on overnight. Test the sensor and adjust its timeout.

Title: Repair washroom cistern inlet valve
Description: The cistern refills slowly. Clean the strainer and check the inlet valve.

Title: Replace entrance mat edging
Description: The entrance mat edge is lifting. Secure the edge to remove the trip hazard.

Title: Service fresh air intake damper
Description: The intake damper sticks halfway open. Clean the linkage and test full travel.

Title: Repair cleaner cupboard lock
Description: The cleaner cupboard key turns without releasing the latch. Replace the lock cylinder.

Title: Inspect roof drain after heavy rain
Description: Water remains around the roof outlet. Clear debris and confirm free drainage.

Title: Replace loading bay warning beacon
Description: The loading bay beacon no longer flashes. Check its supply and replace the failed unit.

Title: Repair acoustic panel fixing
Description: A meeting room wall panel has a loose corner. Refix it and check adjacent panels.

Title: Calibrate server room temperature sensor
Description: The displayed room temperature differs from a handheld reading. Check and calibrate the sensor.

Title: Inspect west washroom ventilation
Description: A ventilation service request needs the missing visit date corrected before scheduling.

Title: Service lobby fan coil unit
Description: The lobby fan coil needs a routine clean and airflow check. Confirm the deadline before booking.

Title: Replace lobby light fixture
Description: The same lobby fixture is already on the maintenance list. Check the reference before approving.
